title: Sony launches Quick Spectral Super Resolution, a "new performance tier of AI upscaling" for the standard PS5 developed in collaboration with AMD (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Sony launches Quick Spectral Super Resolution, a “new performance tier of AI upscaling” for the standard PS5 developed in collaboration with AMD — Sony's new Quick Spectral Super Resolution AI upscaling is coming first to Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei.
